Hi Jordan — great to meet earlier today.

Thanks again for the time and for walking through the evaluation. A quick recap and next steps from our side so your procurement team has what they need:  

- Commercial path options: we support credit-card self-serve for lower-value pilots, standard PO/net-30 invoicing for enterprise customers, and listings on public cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure).
- Marketplace note: AWS Marketplace is typically the fastest for customers already using AWS (consolidated billing, SaaS subscriptions). We also support private listings if you need SSO/ID-based entitlements.
- Procurement asks you flagged: vendor setup form + vendor/company W-9 or equivalent, preferred payment method (PO vs card), and rough timeline for PO issuance.

Next steps I can own from Redwood:
1) Send our standard vendor onboarding packet and a Marketplace one-pager (if you want AWS/GCP specific notes).
2) Lukas will prepare an initial pilot quote and term options (monthly with option to convert to committed Dedicated).
3) If you prefer marketplace, tell us which provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) and we’ll surface the best activation path.

If you can send the vendor setup form and confirm whether procurement prefers PO+invoice or card, we’ll move the quote to final.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the packet in a separate email.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Quick answers from procurement/finance here:  

- Preference: LumenAI prefers to purchase via AWS Marketplace when possible (consolidated billing + SaaS subscriptions). If Marketplace isn’t an option we will go with PO/net-30.
- Vendor onboarding: attaching our vendor setup form (includes tax info, payment remit, and vendor contact). Could you confirm Redwood's legal/business name and tax ID as it should appear on the form?
- Timeline: once we have a marketplace listing or a formal quote to attach to a PO, we typically issue a PO in ~10 business days (subject to legal review).

Also please confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO that references usage-based billing (per-token) or if you require a minimum committed spend for enterprise terms.

Thanks — attaching vendor form.

Jordan Bishop

- Marketplace vs PO: AWS Marketplace is supported and we have an active SaaS listing. - Timeline note: for AWS Marketplace subscriptions, activation is usually 2–5 business days (once we enable the subscription on our side). For PO/onboard we estimate 7–14 business days after vendor packet + signed SOW/quote.
